'''''Blechnum occidentale''''' is a [[fern]] in the family [[Blechnaceae]].<ref name=CFLW/> Its native range is from Mexico through Central America and the Caribbean to tropical South America.<ref name=POWO_33632-2/>

''Blechnum scaberulum'' and ''Blechnum sodiroi'' have been regarded as separate species, but are now regarded as [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonyms]] of ''Blechnum occidentale''.<ref name=CFLW/><ref name=POWO_33632-2/>
